mapper.select: SELECT meetings_id, host_id, title, status, invite_code, default_lang, meeting_mode, scheduled_at, created_at, updated_at, ended_at, is_private, COALESCE(culture_desc, '') AS culture_desc, COALESCE(culture_desc, '') AS cultureDesc, COALESCE(culture_thumb_rel_path, '') AS culture_thumb_rel_path, COALESCE(culture_thumb_rel_path, '') AS cultureThumbRelPath FROM tl_meetings WHERE ${pk} = #{id} AND host_id = #{hostId}

SELECT meetings_id, host_id, title, status, invite_code, default_lang, meeting_mode, scheduled_at, created_at, updated_at, ended_at, is_private, COALESCE(culture_desc, '') AS culture_desc, COALESCE(culture_desc, '') AS cultureDesc, COALESCE(culture_thumb_rel_path, '') AS culture_thumb_rel_path, COALESCE(culture_thumb_rel_path, '') AS cultureThumbRelPath FROM tl_meetings WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT meetings_id, host_id, title, status, invite_code, default_lang, meeting_mode, scheduled_at, created_at, updated_at, ended_at, is_private, COALESCE(culture_desc, '') AS culture_desc, COALESCE(culture_desc, '') AS cultureDesc, COALESCE(culture_thumb_rel_path, '') AS culture_thumb_rel_path, COALESCE(culture_thumb_rel_path, '') AS cultureThumbRelPath FROM tl_meetings WHERE host_id = #{hostId} AND title = #{title} AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','ONGOING') AND (updated_at >= #{since} OR scheduled_at >= #{since}) ORDER BY updated_at DESC, meetings_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tl_meetings (host_id, title, status, invite_code, default_lang, scheduled_at, meeting_mode, culture_thumb_rel_path, culture_desc, is_private, private_password) VALUES (#{hostId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{inviteCode}, #{defaultLang}, #{scheduledAt}, #{meetingMode}, #{cultureThumbRelPath}, #{cultureDesc}, #{isPrivate}, #{privatePassword})
mapper.update: UPDATE tl_meetings SET status = 'ONGOING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ${pk} = #{id} AND host_id = #{hostId}
UPDATE tl_meetings SET status = 'ENDED', ended_at = #{endedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ${pk} = #{id} AND host_id = #{hostId}
UPDATE tl_meetings SET invite_code = #{inviteCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ${pk} = #{id} AND host_id = #{hostId}
